metadata.evidence_policy: market evidence is distinct from ZEVANORY hypotheses

observed: five one-time digital products
Conteúdo Pronto listed at R$197/month
free guides and calculators
three software products marked coming soon
sources.limitation: catalog presence and price do not prove demand, payment or retention

observed: 12 posts, 4 WhatsApp sales messages and a 30-day calendar per month
automatic monthly renewal is described
delivery is described as automatic by email
customer reviews and publishes
sources.limitation: page claims describe the offer; no subscriber, fulfillment-cost or churn data was accessed

observed: WhatsApp or Telegram and image/social platforms each reached 74% of companies in the report
among small companies that sold online, 84% used messaging as a sales channel
sources.limitation: population covers formal companies with 10 or more employed people; it is not a MEI or ZEVANORY customer survey

observed: national probability-sample research
target population is companies with 10 or more employed people
sources.limitation: microbusinesses with 1 to 9 employed people are outside the regular 2024 population

observed: Sebrae reports that 76% of MEIs in the cited Pulso survey use social networks and messaging apps to increase sales
sources.limitation: secondary presentation of the Pulso result; use as demand signal, not willingness-to-pay evidence

observed: Sebrae frames cash control as a recurring daily routine for MEIs
the routine supports working-capital and pricing decisions
sources.limitation: guidance establishes recurring need, not demand for a paid ZEVANORY subscription

observed: AI adoption among companies with 10 to 49 employed people rose from 10% in 2024 to 15% in 2025
sources.limitation: does not cover MEIs and does not prove demand for a specific AI product

observed: monthly social-management software subscription listed at R$49.90 for one profile
annual equivalent listed at R$34.90/month
sources.limitation: software for scheduling/management is not equivalent to a done-for-you content service

observed: mLabs reports surveyed social-media service ranges from R$500 to R$3000/month for 12 posts with broader work
sources.limitation: vendor-published survey, older observation and broader service scope; not a price recommendation

observed: free plan exists
Basic listed at R$73/user/month and Pro at R$131/user/month
WhatsApp extension and follow-up features are included in the comparison
sources.limitation: full CRM scope exceeds a lightweight follow-up playbook; listed prices do not prove ZEVANORY willingness to pay

observed: Basic listed at R$989/month on annual billing
WhatsApp API messaging credits can add variable cost
sources.limitation: enterprise conversational platform, not directly comparable to a no-send assistant

observed: monthly Light listed at R$208, Plus at R$312 and Premium at R$479
cash flow, payables and reconciliation are included
sources.limitation: full financial SaaS with operational features; not equivalent to educational routines or templates

observed: financial-management plan listed at R$396/month
includes cash flow, payables, receivables and reports
sources.limitation: full SaaS scope; not evidence for a lightweight ZEVANORY subscription price

observed: government dashboard showed 25.7 million active companies at the observation date
sources.limitation: market size is not addressable demand and includes businesses outside the target profile
